rows.label: qst500106_msg0001
rows.name: Hello, mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0002
rows.name:
Shimashima came here to look for
delicious juice ingredients, mo.

rows.label: qst500106_msg0003
rows.name:
But there's nothing here but the
Cloud Sea, mo...

rows.label: qst500106_msg0004
rows.name:
The others probably found ingredients
and returned to Avaritia Trading
Company already, mo.

rows.label: qst500106_msg0005
rows.name: What should Shimashima do, mo?

rows.label: qst500106_msg0006
rows.name: What advice will you give?

rows.label: qst500106_msg0007
rows.name: Try salvaging!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0008
rows.name: Try gathering from a Divine Beast

rows.label: qst500106_msg0009
rows.name: Mo-mo-mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0010
rows.name:
I was so busy lamenting that I never
thought of that, mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0011
rows.name: I'll jump right in, mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0012
rows.name:
I forgot my Salvager Suit, but I
still found an Angel Engine, mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0013
rows.name:
It doesn't look tasty, but I'll take
it back with me, mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0014
rows.name:
Some of my other siblings are also
looking for juice ingredients, mo.

rows.label: qst500106_msg0015
rows.name:
If you meet them, please be as kind
to them as you were to me, mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0016
rows.name: Please do, mooo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0017
rows.name: Mo-mo-mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0018
rows.name:
Come to think of it, there is a
Divine Beast right behind me, mo.

rows.label: qst500106_msg0019
rows.name:
And looking closely, there's lots of
greenery. I might find tasty
vegetables here, mo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0020
rows.name:
I'll gather some, then get straight
on a ship and head home, mooo!

rows.label: qst500106_msg0021
rows.name:
We run a shop called the Twelve
Nopon Siblings in Avaritia Trading
Company. Stop by sometime, mo!
